verdict.summary: OAR 0.35.0 is conditionally viable for an Environment-hosted Pi replacement with a bounded extension-loader hook; Codex is blocked from OAR production adoption and retains a bounded native exception; Claude is strictly not authorized for production Host-run and requires a named upstream/pre-dispatch native wrapper route under #225 prerequisites.

sharedAdapter.name: OarEngineAdapter
sharedAdapter.cardinality: single shared adapter parameterized by runtime identity, capability, and host policy
sharedAdapter.runnerSupervision: per-session supervised runner process group with explicit process-group timeout and isolation profile
sharedAdapter.seams: preserves existing Sprout EngineAdapter and EngineSession seams without leaking OAR Session types into durable records or Worker protocols
sharedAdapter.credentials: host-local credentials strictly preserved; no credential leakage to remote work origins or untrusted processes
sharedAdapter.placement: Environment-hosted placement retained for this slice; Host-run placement remains governed by #225

pi.route: OAR-based replacement via custom loader/extension hook under Environment-hosted mode; Native Host-run retained for #225
pi.remedy: Upstream or runner-level Pi opener loader policy hook supplying strict tools/noTools options, disabling default native bash/ambient discovery, and enforcing Worker-origin Project MCP transport.
pi.acceptance: Demonstrate model-issued read/edit/command on isolated fixture with native tools unregistered/denied, ambient extensions excluded, and no host-stdio MCP execution.

codex.route: Bounded Native Exception retained (src/engine/codex.ts / native app-server / exec-server); OAR Codex route blocked

nativeException.name: CodexNativeSeamException
nativeException.mechanism: Retain native Sprout EngineAdapter implementation for Codex
nativeException.removalTrigger: Upstream OAR release exposes typed executor binding (thread/start environments) and dynamic-tool dispatch callbacks, tested and verified on Codex >= 0.159.3 without host-stdio MCP fallback or process-global sandbox pollution.

codex.remedy: Upstream OAR typed executor-binding option/hook and dynamic tool callback bridge; runner-level per-session sandbox posture decoupling.
codex.acceptance: Codex session starts with explicit remote Environment binding, issues model turns through Worker-origin tools, and refuses host sentinels without falling back to host execution.

claude.route: Future route gated on upstream #55 attribution fix, native pre-dispatch wrapper for builtin exclusion, and Human CLI installation/auth prerequisites; NOT authorized as production Host-run by #230
claude.evidenceLevel: model-issued (bounded local fixture with non-Claude backend; native nested Agent rejection observed)
prerequisites: Human-owned installation and authentication of Claude Code CLI on the engine host
Upstream #55 attribution resolution or verified projection hook preventing premature root completion
Native pre-dispatch exclusion wrapper (--bare, --tools '', approval denial for non-work tools)
Resolution of five unproved loader/policy boundaries (rules file read denial, automatic plugin discovery, LSP, managed policy, managed MCP)
claude.acceptance: Model-issued turn with genuine Claude backend verifying exact root-turn attribution, complete builtin exclusion, remote Worker MCP transport, and zero host leakage.

orderingAndSequencing.verdict: #225 first / independent execution; OAR adoption does not precede or gate #225
rules: Minimal Codex/Pi replacement via OarEngineAdapter applies strictly to Environment-hosted mode and does not gate independent #225 Host-run execution.
Substrate-independent and Pi-vertical #225 work (#237-#247) proceeds independently of #226 runtime migration.
Codex retains native exception in both modes until upstream OAR controls exist.
Closing research issue #230 does not authorize production Host-run or unproven OAR routes.
Downstream tickets #231-#236 are bounded planning drafts and must respect the blocked states and native exceptions recorded here.

upstreamDriftFinding.finding: OAR upstream has drifted from 0.35.0 to 0.58.0. In accordance with constraints, OAR is not floated or upgraded in this run scope. Upstream drift is recorded as a finding for future evaluation.

conversationWithoutWorkEnvironment.evidence: #252 proved bounded PONG baseline on native Pi and Claude without Environment or leases; OAR route unproven for standalone no-env conversation.

enrolledRemoteOperationMcpOrigin.evidence: OAR 0.35.0 launches MCP stdio on the engine host (violating ADR-0019). #244/#245 proved Worker-origin HTTP/stdio MCP natively; OAR requires Sprout-managed HTTP MCP bridging or upstream remote-origin transport.

accessLeaseEnforcement.evidence: Task mutation leases enforced at Sprout runtime/operations layer; OAR carries no native lease concept.

staleBindingRejection.evidence: OAR cannot dynamically refresh tool bindings in-place (withdraw affects inputs only). Re-binding requires session disposal and fresh session creation, which rejects stale authority.

uncertainOperationRecovery.evidence: OAR abort() is only cancellation delivery; settlement must be verified by Sprout runner supervision and Worker delivery journal.
